definitions: A group of rare, fatal brain diseases affecting humans and animals, caused by abnormally folded proteins called prions.
Neurodegenerative disorders characterized by the accumulation of misfolded prion proteins in the brain, leading to spongiform changes.
examples: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease is a type of prion disease.
Research into prion disease is ongoing.
Symptoms of prion disease include rapid dementia.
